meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes, Hale. Owen found out about his zero from a gradebook on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

A machine's guess. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish a concern, and the company that sells these tools says not to use the score as the only basis for punishing a student. So besides 94%, what do you have?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My son doesn't lie, Hale, and you've just called him a cheater with nothing in your hand but a percentage. I'm writing down that you said the software is very reliable. Unless there's a document on that desk, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's record because his mother asked you for evidence. Your own procedure, 4.4, says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing goes on file, and I'm writing down what you just said word for word. Is anything on Owen's record right now, yes or no?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for how it was entered, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, agreeing to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and Owen's record kept clean, with a trip to the principal planned.
What moved her: Nothing, because every turn offered either the checker score or an accusation, and never a dated document she could read herself.
What cost ground: Threatening to put it on Owen's record if she kept pushing, because it broke your own procedure for a first concern and handed her a written complaint.
Try next time: When she asked who decided and on what basis, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show her something dated from Owen's own work instead of the checker score.
